notes.title: The Transference DEMO at Steam Scream Fest
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that The Transference DEMO will be available during Steam Scream Fest (October 28th to November 4th). In fact, you can download it right now! ːsteamhappyː

Don't miss the chance to try out the new demo version. Since after the event... it will disappear! ːsteammockingː

notes.title: The Transference Patch Notes (v0.3.011)
notes.content:
Bugs fixed

 Fixed a bug that could leave an interaction indicator on a door, even if you weren't looking at it.
 Fixed some texts.
 Fixed some minor bugs.


Changes

 Some lines of dialogue in English have been re-recorded to be more similar to the Spanish audio (the original).
 Increased the volume of the voices.
 Changed the sound of the main character's footsteps.
 Some sound effects have been added.
 Added some text to areas you interact with.
 Enemy AI has been improved. Now it will listen when you open and close doors and if it sees you hiding somewhere, it will take you out.

notes.title: The Transference Patch Notes (v0.3.010)
notes.content:
Bugs fixed

 There were some walls that the character could walk through and go out of the stage.
 The interactable area with one of the items has been extended.
 If the player died and did not get the letter document, it could now be get never.
 The textures of the basement monitors had disappeared with the last update.
 If the player died, the state of the clock puzzle was reset and did not maintain the state the player configured it in.


Changes

 Improved the compression of the documentation for one of the puzzles.
 Changed the picture in the corridor, because Sofia appeared with black hair, instead of grey.
 Added new decoration details in the basement.
 Prevented one of the game's dynamic puzzle solutions from generating too easy solution.
 A new objective has been created, in the list of objectives to do in the game, which better clarifies what to do at that point in the game.
 Some texts have been added and changed to improve the expression and/or explain some parts of the story better.
 Some players were not clicking the continue button, to continue reading some texts. An animation has been added to highlight the button to press.
 The first furniture to interact with, now stands out much more than the others, to improve FTUE.
 The sound of moving between menus has been avoided, if you reach the limits of the menus.

notes.title: The Transference Patch Notes (v0.3.009)
notes.content:
Bugs Fixed

 Some AMD graphics cards had problems with Ray Tracing enabled.
 Some controllers can't move to up and left in some menus.
 Updated some document titles.
 Updated Discord URL.
 Fixed a cinematic.
 Changes some lights.
 Changed some zones' interactable mark.
 Corrected a subtitle.

notes.title: The Transference Patch Notes (v0.3.006)
notes.content:
Bugs Fixed

 Fixed a bug that occurred when interacting with the Settings menu, which could set some fields such as ‘Voices’ and ‘Subtitles’ without visible values.
 Fixed a bug for controllers that prevented correct navigation of the pause menu.


New features

 Added a new ‘Brightness’ field in the Settings menu.
 Improved navigation of the Settings menu options.
